description: Update a dashboard. Two modes. (1) Metadata-only: pass just icon/assignTo/filters/isDefault/settings, with no spec fields and no revision. (2) Spec update: pass the FULL spec — title, source, dateRange, sections, widgets — plus `revision`. Widgets and sections are REPLACED, not merged, so call get_dashboard first and resend everything you want to keep. `revision` is the optimistic-concurrency token from get_dashboard/list_dashboards: the server accepts the write only if it still matches, then increments it. A 409 conflict means another writer saved first — re-fetch with get_dashboard, rebuild your changes on the fresh spec, and retry with the new revision. Viewer settings (the settings input): Do not pass settings unless the user explicitly asks to change this dashboard's viewer settings. Never pass settings for a Foxtons dashboard unless explicitly asked; Foxtons moves by a server script. Saving any settings section moves that dashboard onto the settings flow immediately: its media pages use these groups and this Feedback setup from then on. Each section (fields, feedback) replaces that whole section when sent. Call get_dashboard first and resend every key of the section you change; a key left out resets to its default. Get field ids from list_fields. Ids that are not the company's fields are dropped when saving. When feedback.isEnabled is true, pass a non-empty feedback.fieldIds (score fields) rather than leaving it empty. Only set feedback.sheetWebhookUrl when the user gives the Apps Script URL.

assignTo.description: User ids, or group ids in the "<groupId> (G)" convention, to share view access with

dateRange.description: Date range — strict preset only, no free-form start/end dates

preset.description: One of: last7days | last30days | last3months | yearToDate | allTime

filters.description: Field filters. filters.filterList is an array of { fieldName, fieldOperator?, fieldValue?: string[], fieldCondition? }. Other keys pass through but only filterList is enforced.

isDefault.description: Make this the company default dashboard

revision.description: The revision loaded from get_dashboard. Required for spec updates; mismatch returns a 409 conflict.

sections.description: Optional named widget groups (tabs). Each references widgets by their explicit ids; widgets in no section form the implicit Overview group.

widgetIds.description: Widget ids in this section — must match explicit `id`s set on widgets[]

settings.description: Viewer settings for media pages opened from this dashboard's share link: which fields show, how the Fields tab groups them, and the Feedback button. Do not pass settings unless the user explicitly asks to change this dashboard's viewer settings. Never pass settings for a Foxtons dashboard unless explicitly asked; Foxtons moves by a server script. Saving any settings section moves that dashboard onto the settings flow immediately: its media pages use these groups and this Feedback setup from then on. Each section (fields, feedback) replaces that whole section when sent. Call get_dashboard first and resend every key of the section you change; a key left out resets to its default. Get field ids from list_fields. Ids that are not the company's fields are dropped when saving. When feedback.isEnabled is true, pass a non-empty feedback.fieldIds (score fields) rather than leaving it empty. Only set feedback.sheetWebhookUrl when the user gives the Apps Script URL.

allowOtherSubmitter.description: Lets a reviewer type a name that is not in submitters.

fieldIds.description: Fields a reviewer gives feedback on. Empty means every field the media page shows.

fieldRules.description: Per feedback field: a short row label and the allowed score range, used for both the reviewer's score and the approver's score.

groups.description: Pills in the Feedback dialog, each listing feedback field ids in order. Leave out to reuse fields.groups.

isEnabled.description: Show the Feedback button on media pages opened from this shared dashboard

removeReasons.description: Reasons for removing a call from scoring. Empty hides that option.

reviewScope.description: 'dashboard' (default) lists and reviews only this dashboard's feedback; 'company' lists every dashboard's feedback in the company. Use 'company' only on a manager dashboard, never on a personal one.

sheetWebhookUrl.description: Google Apps Script web app URL that receives one row per submission. Only script.google.com addresses are posted to. Never shown to viewers.

submitters.description: Names a reviewer picks from. Empty lets them type their own name.

groups.description: Pills on the media page Fields tab, each listing the field ids it shows. Empty means no pills.

includeIds.description: Field ids a viewer sees on each media page opened from this shared dashboard, in this order. Private fields are shown when listed. Empty shows only the company's public fields.

orderIds.description: Used only when includeIds is empty: these fields show first, in this order, then every other public field. Does not change which fields are visible.

folderIds.description: Folder ids — required when type is "folders", forbidden otherwise

type.description: folders = specific folder ids; team = the caller's team scope; workspace = everything accessible

title.description: Dashboard name — required (with revision) when updating the spec

widgets.description: Widgets to place on the dashboard, in order (max 24). The MCP assigns ids and computes a tidy two-per-row grid layout matching the Speak UI unless you pass explicit id/layout.

binding.description: Per-widget scope override: { source?, dateRange?: {preset}, filter? }. Omit any key to inherit the dashboard's value.

config.description: Per-type config (STRICT — unknown keys are rejected). metric-chart: mark (line|bar|area|donut|stacked-bar) + metric + groupBy/series + thresholds; table: rowsAre + columns [{header, field|metric}]; stat-cards: tiles; field-distribution: fieldName+measure+chartType (required); narrative: focus; notes: content; chat-history: limit (optional, past conversations to list, 1-100, default 25). Call list_dashboard_widgets for the full per-type vocabulary + metric/filter grammar. Omit for a sensible valid default (except field-distribution, which needs fieldName).

id.description: Optional explicit widget id (kebab-case). Required if you reference the widget from sections[].widgetIds; auto-generated otherwise.

layout.description: Explicit 12-column grid position. Omit to auto-place two-per-row like the UI. Widgets must not overlap within a section group.

title.description: Widget title, max 40 chars (defaults to a per-type label)

type.description: Widget type: narrative | stat-cards | metric-chart | table | comparison | field-distribution | sentiment-trend | themes | people | team-activity | notes | chat-history

name: update_dashboard

data.description: Response payload from the Speak AI API
